data.narrative:
LabGenius, a Seed-stage biotech company founded by James Field, has raised $73M to date. The company operates within a Biotech & Health sector peer universe comprising 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Given data constraints, only the Stage-Progression method is applicable. Using $27M as a proxy for early-stage valuation derived from total capital raised, a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $68M. The Peer-Median approach cannot be applied—while 7 same-sector peers exist, none satisfy narrow filtering criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier) at the threshold of 3+ comparable datapoints required for statistical reliability. Public-Comp Anchoring is similarly inapplicable; the public Biotech & Health median trades at 6.2x Price-to-Sales, but LabGenius's revenue remains undisclosed, preventing ratio application.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $57M (low) to $78M (high), centered on $68M. This range reflects a ±15% sensitivity band around the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer-stage valuation data, undisclosed revenue metrics that would anchor public comparable multiples, and the typical opacity of pre-exit private biotech valuations. Validation would require additional market data on recent financings within the immediate peer cohort.
